title: Rowlight: Crochet Companion
shortDescription: Keep your row, follow patterns and organise crochet projects offline.
fullDescription:
Keep your place while you crochet. Count rows and repeats, save project notes, follow pasted pattern steps and use photos with a movable reading guide. Explore gauge, yarn and amigurumi tools, then export a backup of your work.

Your projects are stored on your device. Android PDFs currently open in another app; use page images for the in-app reading guide.
releaseBlockers: Plus purchasing is a dev-only mock; Play Billing required
Android file export/import and persistence device QA
assets: Android device screenshots, 512px store icon and 1024x500 feature graphic still require verification
